purpose: Python functional verification of continuous sensing, path-event timing, buffering and fixed-RBF batch conditioning; no policy ranking, GRG execution, ROS motion or real-map validation.
path_note: Saved Nav2 detour geometry translated into a temporary domain and traversed out/back twice. Actual progress and pauses are synthetic time profiles, not a new Nav2/physics run.
history_note: Synthetic SRF history sized to the current real training count; no real ENU coordinates are registered or re-used as map coordinates.
kernel_note: Reuse frozen physical-unit RBF hyperparameters for computational verification only, not the trained checkpoint conditioning data or a claim of real-field accuracy.
scale_note: 3920 is a hypothetical 4x-history workload, not four available real datasets.
scheduling_note: Virtual trajectory time and measured CPU wall time are separate. This test does not certify a complete 120 s ROS mission budget.
invalid_record_rule: Reject bad quality, nonfinite values and out-of-domain inputs. Deduplicate stable measurement IDs, not spatially repeated visits.
failure_update_rule: Flush valid buffered observations on interruption; no fabricated measurements after interruption.
